narrative.intro: Spencer Construction obligated $2.4B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Spencer Construction received 5 awards so far, with an average award size of $472M. Spencer Construction obligations are up 321227.1% year over year. Spencer Construction had prior-year activity concentrated in a few small years: FY22 totaled $15.3M, FY23 totaled $72.9K, FY25 totaled $735K, and FY21 and FY24 each totaled $0. The current-year totals are partial. The note states that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Readers should treat the FY2026 figures as fiscal year to date rather than a full-year total.
